name: Pork Chops with Cherry Balsamic Sauce, Couscous & Green Beans

instructions.primary_message: Place couscous in a large bowl.

Pour broth in a medium saucepan, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Remove from heat, pour broth into the bowl with the couscous, and stir. Cover tightly with aluminum foil and let stand for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Meanwhile, peel and mince onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Return saucepan to medium heat. Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion and garlic to the saucepan and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Add cherries, vinegar, and salt to the saucepan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until cherries have softened and balsamic is slightly reduced, about 12 minutes. Cover and remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cup frozen cherries
⅓ cup balsamic vinegar
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a large plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Working in batches if necessary, place chops in the skillet and cook, flipping once, until browned and cooked through, 6-7 minutes. Remove to a clean plate and cover with foil.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and trim green beans.
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green beans and season with salt and pepper. Cook, tossing frequently, until bright green and tender-crisp, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slice pork chops against the grain.
To serve, divide couscous, green beans, and pork chops between plates. Top chops with cherry sauce and enjoy!
